howToPlay: Use your basic attack to build up the freeze meter on opponents until they are stunned. Throw your Super to create a slippery area that damages enemies and slows their movement. Utilize your gadgets to stay protected or instantly increase the freeze effect on targets.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase your output while low on health, or SUPER CHARGE to gain access to your icy area more frequently.
trait: This controller excels at disrupting enemy positioning and crowd control in fast-paced matches.
